original_ai_output.title_zh: 坦布拉妇女跨越族群分歧重建和平：“我们曾经彼此恐惧，如今像姐妹一样拥抱”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州坦布拉地区曾因族群紧张和社区冲突而分裂，流离失所的妇女彼此不敢往来。在联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）支持下，妇女们通过咖啡聚会重建信任与友谊。当地妇女领袖表示，她们正把对话扩展到坦布拉中心以外的多个流离失所者营地，以推动基层和平。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹西赤道州坦布拉地区妇女通过咖啡聚会跨越族群分歧重建信任
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Through coffee gatherings supported by the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS), women from previously divided communities are rebuilding friendships and learning to trust one another again.

key_facts.fact: 当地妇女称冲突期间行动自由受限，彼此甚至不敢交谈
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: During the conflict, there was no freedom of movement. We did not even speak to one another. Now, when we see each other, we hug like sisters.

key_facts.fact: 一名流离失所妇女称，过去跨越到营地另一侧可能被认出并遭绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: What frightened me most was that if I crossed to the other side, people would identify me and abduct me

key_facts.fact: 妇女们正把对话扩展到坦布拉中心以外的多个流离失所者营地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: these women are expanding their conversations beyond Tambura Centre, bringing representatives from different displacement camps together

uncertainties: 事件为单一来源报道（UNMISS），尚缺乏其他独立来源交叉验证
报道未提供族群冲突的具体伤亡或事件细节
